given: a Reel draft with a primary video and Media-Studio flag on
then: the Sous-titres track is visible with a "Générer les sous-titres" action
test_id: MediaStudio.subtitles.test.tsx > flag on + reel => Sous-titres track present

given: the Sous-titres track in empty state and mode=mock
when: the operator clicks Générer les sous-titres
then: a role='subtitles' asset is created with provider='rule-based' costCents=0 and the CueEditor is populated with timed cues
test_id: generate-subtitles-for-draft.test.ts > mode=mock => rule-based SRT no provider call

given: mode=mock (or live refine=false)
when: the subtitles are generated or saved
then: no HTTP request is made to any provider host
test_id: test-plan-msw.md default-path no-network proof (request:start spy = [])

given: the draft script has no hook and no scenes
then: a transient empty result is returned (id='' cueCount=0) nothing is persisted and a "Aucun texte à sous-titrer" hint is shown
test_id: generate-subtitles-for-draft.test.ts > empty script => transient nothing persisted

given: a generated subtitles asset
when: the operator edits a cue and clicks Enregistrer
then: the PUT persists re-indexed canonical SRT and meta.srt is byte-identical to the .srt asset
test_id: save-subtitles-for-draft.test.ts > persists meta.srt byte-identical to the .srt asset bytes

given: two cues where cue 2 starts before cue 1 ends
then: the server returns 400 invalid_input with details.cueErrors listing the overlap and the save is blocked
test_id: save-subtitles.route.test.ts > 400 invalid_input with details.cueErrors on overlapping cues

given: a cue line longer than 42 characters
then: the server returns 400 invalid_input with a line_length cueError including the char count
test_id: save-subtitles-for-draft.test.ts > rejects over-long line (>42)

given: refine=true in live mode with no IA key configured
then: the request fails with 409 invalid_state and no asset is written and no provider call is made
test_id: generate-subtitles.route.test.ts > 409 invalid_state when cookie=live refine=true no key (no provider call)

given: refine=true with a valid key and the LLM returns 5xx
then: the service returns 502 upstream_failed and does not write a fake asset
test_id: generate-subtitles-for-draft.test.ts > mode=live + refine + key + 5xx => upstream_failed

given: a draft whose format is not Reel/Story
then: the service returns 409 invalid_state Sous-titres réservés aux formats vidéo
test_id: generate-subtitles-for-draft.test.ts > non-video draft => HttpError invalid_state

given: an SRT round-trip
then: parseTimecode(formatTimecode(ms))===ms and serializeSrt(parseSrt(x))===x for canonical x
test_id: srt.test.ts > formatTimecode/parseTimecode round-trip;> round-trip idempotent

given: the operator chooses a burn-in style (position/size/box)
then: the SubtitleOverlayPreview reflects the style live and the style is persisted in meta.style
test_id: SubtitleOverlayPreview.test.tsx > renders the first cue text positioned per style

when: the operator opens the publish confirm dialog
then: the track summary shows a Sous-titres row and publishing runs in dry-run
test_id: PublishActionGroup.subtitles.test.tsx > shows sous-titres in track summary when present

given: the CueEditor with an invalid cue

then: focus moves to the offending cue field for correction
